07 Common questions

Before you ask us

Straight answers, no jargon. Anything else — ask on WhatsApp and the founder replies himself.

How much does a website cost?

It depends on what you need: landing pages start at PKR 15,000, e-commerce stores at PKR 35,000, and custom web apps at PKR 60,000. Care plans start at PKR 5,000/month. You get a fixed quote before we start.

How long does it take?

A landing page usually takes 3–5 days and an e-commerce store around 10 days, like Boutique Lahore's. Bigger web apps are planned with you step by step.

Can you accept JazzCash & EasyPaisa on my store?

Yes — Pakistani payment methods are built into our e-commerce work from the start, along with cash on delivery if you want it.

What do you need from me to start?

Just a free discovery call. Tell us about your business and goals — we handle design, build, launch and training.
